description: 1 double bedroom, 1 single bedroom, 1 full bathroom, 1 WC, open plan living-kitchen-dining, 1 storage room. Single-aspect apartment, windows on bottom facade. Kitchen at bottom of open plan space, wall counter, no kitchen island. Kitchen adjacent to the bottom facade wall, well-lit cooking position. Cook faces the bottom wall, back to dining and seating. Living arrangement: linear top-to-bottom, seating at top, coffee table center, dining lower, kitchen at bottom. Dining table visible, approximately 6 seats. No TV clearly visible. Bathroom config: 1 full bathroom; 1 WC-only room. Parallel morning routines possible. Both bedrooms on right side accessed from corridor. No en-suite. Single bedroom large enough for bunk bed. Possible configurations: (1) children's bedroom; (2) home office or hobby room; (3) guest room; (4) bunk bed. Storage room adjacent to kitchen zone, usable as kitchen pantry, laundry or general storage. Entry from right near bottom of wall. Door separates entry corridor from living area. Suits couples needing a spare room, people working from home.
not_suitable_for: families with two or more children
